warning_source: Shin Bet monitoring / Hamas communications activity
recipient: Shin Bet operational-intelligence chain; exact senior recipients unresolved
warning_summary: During Ramadan 2023 the Shin Bet detected activation of 37 Israeli SIM cards held by Hamas operatives. Later investigations established this as important comparison context for the Oct. 6-7 SIM-card signal, but the 2023 episode ended without an attack.
evidence_state: The Shin Bet's post-Oct. 7 internal investigation, reported by Ynet/N12/Walla in March 2025, explicitly states that 37 SIMs were activated during Ramadan 2023 and that Hamas did not attack then. 2026 reporting adds that the emoji/mobilization meaning associated with similar activity was discovered only retrospectively.
gaps: No evidence recovered that the Ramadan 2023 SIM activity was contemporaneously interpreted as an impending-attack warning or delivered as such to a qualifying senior decision-maker. Do not promote to a warning event without a contemporaneous alert/assessment, named recipient or documented readiness decision tied to this episode.

warning_source: Col. Haim Cohen / Northern Gaza Brigade commander
recipient: Southern Command / IDF chain; qualifying government receipt unestablished
warning_summary: Cohen later said the sector had been hot for roughly six weeks before Oct. 7 and that he proposed an opening/preemptive strike up the chain.
evidence_state: Lane-1 recheck found no new contemporaneous order, briefing, message, independent delivery record or authoritative inquiry finding corroborating the retrospective claim. Existing contrary accounts from people around Southern Command commander Yaron Finkelman remain material.
gaps: Remain unresolved; do not accept a post-event 'I warned them' claim without contemporaneous or independent corroboration and a qualifying recipient chain.

recipient: Aharon Haliva and Herzi Halevi; intended for PM/cabinet but not sent before attack

gaps: Keep excluded from government-warning count unless pre-attack delivery to a qualifying government recipient is established; original draft remains a high-value recovery target.
